messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: variable dll not found in modelValues
parts:
Samuel, it looks like the error is coming from your use of the str() function on the compiled model object:

str(compile.nc.sids.Model)

That's what's causing the error.  It turns out nimble's compiled objects (which are wrappers to invoke a call to compiled C++ code) do not play nicely with str(), and that's something we can address in a future release.  But for now,

(1) You can get additional information about the model object by querying the model using the model API functions, such as:

nc.sids.Model$initializeInfo()
nc.sids.Model$getNodeNames()
nc.sids.Model$getDependencies("tau")

(2) If you omit the call to str(), then the rest of your code seems to execute without any problems.

Cheers,
Daniel
